extracted.name: All-day omelet
extracted.description: Omelets are a great mix-and-match dish!
ingredient_lines: Salt and black pepper for seasoning
instruction_lines: Pour half of the egg mixture in the pan, and then add mix-ins
Pour the rest of the mix over
Let the omelet cook on the first side for 1-2 minutes (the edges should cook before attempting to flip)
Flip! Try to get as much of the omelet as you can onto the spatula before flipping.
